mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_period (user_id, start_date, end_date, amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.budget_start_day, u.default_budget, MAX(p.end_date) AS last_end_date FROM users u JOIN budget_period p ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.budget_enabled = 1 AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.budget_start_day, u.default_budget HAVING MAX(p.end_date) < #{today}
